title: Asymptotic total influence error
statement: For each nonnegative integer $m$, let $E_m$ be the total influence of majority on the sign cube of dimension $2m+1$ minus $\sqrt{2/\pi}\sqrt{2m+1}$. As $m\to\infty$, this error is $O((2m+1)^{-1/2})$.
hypotheses_covered: The index $m$ ranges over nonnegative integers
The asymptotic comparison is taken as $m\to\infty$
